events.detail:
Implemented Signal Drift as a complete procedural Three.js game in [main.ts](/workspace/src/main.ts) with responsive styling in [style.css](/workspace/src/style.css).

Included:

- Three ordered relay gates, extraction, charge pickups, moving hazards, collisions, scoring, victory/failure, and restart
- Keyboard steering/boost plus mobile joystick and boost controls
- Responsive HUD, title screen, pause state, and result screens
- Procedural craft, cloud layer, skyway, towers, lighting, particles/trails, and impact feedback
- Frame-rate-independent movement and visibility pause
- Required `window.__AETHERPLAY__` state contract
- No external assets or application network requests

Checks:

- `npm run build` — passed
- Production preview and local asset HTTP checks — passed
- Output generated in [dist](/workspace/dist)

Desktop and 390×844 browser play inspection could not be performed because the supplied environment contains no browser executable or automation dependency. I did not install one because network access was prohibited.
